pages.title: World storage
pages.text: Files live in the world’s simply_speakers_audios folder as UUID.mp3 or UUID.wav.$(br2)Back up the folder and stop the server before editing its manifest.

pages.title: Manifest records
pages.text: audio_manifest.json maps each recording UUID to uuid, originalFilename, ownerUUID and durationSeconds.$(br2)Set a player owner; unowned recordings cannot be selected.

pages.title: URL bookmarks
pages.text: Direct URL entries also have a Library UUID and owner.$(br2)Their remoteUrl field points to the source. They have no local audio file and start with unknown duration.
